decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials and finishes to be used in the construction of all the external surfaces of the hereby permitted building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first use of the building hereby approved, the applicant shall submit a Landscape Plan to be approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. The plan shall show landscaping to screen the building from views from the Thames Path and Chiswick Bridge and at least three trees to replace the Acacia trees that are to be felled. The replacement trees shall be at least 1.5 metres in height at the time of planting, capable of growing to a height of 6.0 metres. The Landscape Plan shall include details of the species used, a maintenance plan and shall be implemented in full prior to the first use of the building.

Condition : 6 - In the event of the death or disease of the screening vegetation planted in accordance with Condition 4, the applicant shall replace the dead or diseased vegetation within one growing season.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first use of the building hereby permitted, details of the following items relating to the Thames Path where it crosses the site, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing:

(i)	Path surfaces
(ii)	Bollards to protect pedestrians
(iii)	Signage to the northwest and southeast external walls of the existing clubhouse, which states the Thames Path should not be obstructed at any time

The applicant shall carry out these details as approved, prior to the first use of the building and thereafter permanently maintain them in a good condition.
description: Erection of a new single storey detached boathouse for use as storage of single sculled rowboats
